bagPolicy.summary: The arena FAQ says there is no venue-wide bag ban; check the particular concert for any additional restriction.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The arena lists transit and nearby car-park options, and provides 1,000 bicycle parking spaces.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: If you arrive by paratransit, drop-off and pick-up are at entrance C, which has an accessible entrance and an elevator to all seating levels.

concessions.summary: You can't bring your own food or drinks, or any bottles regardless of material or content. Bar and restaurant hours vary by event, so check your event page. Bars usually have a 20-year age limit for alcohol.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking with a valid permit is available at Globen Shopping and Arenagaraget, subject to availability.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No. Once you've entered and leave, you can't come back in, because your ticket has already been used.

ticketPickup.summary: Ticket counters are on the northern and southern sides of 3Arena and are generally open during events, though hours vary. If tickets are available, you can buy and pick them up there. The easiest way to use your ticket is in the app, which is required if you chose Mobile ID delivery.

gates.summary: Scan your ticket from the Stockholm Live app at the entrance, and charge your phone before you arrive. If your ticket won't scan, the ticketing office can help; 3Arena has ticket counters on its northern and southern sides. Door times vary by event, so check your event page.
